notes.label: Why these passages are compared
notes.text: Robertson’s heading for §105 describes Jesus giving the model prayer again and explicitly refers back to §54. Gospel Atlas compares the wording while retaining these as two settings in Robertson’s arrangement.

notes.label: Cross-reference source and reading boundaries
notes.text: OpenBible.info links Matthew 6:9 to Luke 11:1–4. Gospel Atlas selects Matthew 6:9–13 and Luke 11:2–4 for the prayer itself; Luke’s introductory setting remains available through Read context. OpenBible draws primarily from the Treasury of Scripture Knowledge, but its export does not identify the source of each individual link. These sources are not counted as independent endorsements.

notes.label: What the wording comparison means
notes.text: Highlights compare the selected edition’s exact imported wording. Differences may reflect the passages and the edition’s underlying textual choices; they do not by themselves establish authorial additions or deletions. Each edition’s text and available source notes are preserved.
